- Downloads, Series and movies: the season covers are upright again (the series poster with the season over it). The "Trust this server" button is on the add-on's own line now, under its certificate message, with the fingerprint; before, it was further down the screen and could not be seen.
- Download manager: its settings (the gear at the top of the page) open its own settings now, not the Installer's. There is one setting: the key for the season pictures. Each season shows its own picture (from themoviedb.org) when a free TMDB API key is given there; without a key each season shows the series picture, as before.
